newsitem.title: USA: Kodak says to introduce new digital products.
newsitem.headline: Kodak says to introduce new digital products.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said Thursday it will sustain its digital imaging growth with new products it is introducing this year, and that it will continue to invest in emerging markets.
The company's chief executive officer George Fisher, along with other senior executives, made these statements in a press release following a presentation with investors and news media.
The company said it plans to distinguish itself from comptitors with digital products and digitalization products and services.
The company said its digital and applied imaging unit will roll out new products this year.
